name: Indiginus Torch
help: Indiginus Torch Electric Guitar. In Kontakt: StrumMaker OFF, Sequencer OFF, Articulations = Off (or Up Slides if you want hard accents to slide, then raise noteVelocity[1] above 109), Mutes ON (low velocity = mute). Torch has no keyswitches; we play the notes. Our notes stay between velocity 50 and 105 so the high-velocity articulation layer never fires; chops and ghost notes use velocity 30-38 (the Mutes layer). Narrow "range" to the keys Kontakt colours as playable.
